title: The automatic retry tick thread has no panic boundary around the tick body, so a panic there stops every automatic retry for the life of the process
outcome: The automatic retry tick thread has no panic boundary around the tick body, so a panic there stops every automatic retry for the life of the process
acceptance: A panic inside one retry tick is logged and the retry tick thread keeps ticking; a test (or a factored loop step) shows a panicking tick followed by a normal tick that still runs due attempts.
